launcher_source:
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
rem Step-3.7-Flash optimized web chat: expert cache, pipeline, allocation reuse, batch copies.
rem MTP is off; the separate MTP probe is limited to 480 total tokens.
set "STEP_PROFILE=%~dp0build-local\step35-cuda\step18-fast-profile\step37.json"
if not exist "%~dp0.venv\Scripts\python.exe" (
    echo ERROR: Python environment .venv is missing.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
if not exist "%STEP_PROFILE%" (
    echo ERROR: Step optimized profile is missing. See docs\Step-3.7-Flash\STEP37_FLASH_FAST_LAUNCH.md
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
if not exist "%~dp0build-local\step35-cuda\bin\strata-step35-fast.exe" (
    echo ERROR: strata-step35-fast.exe is missing. See the launch guide.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
echo Step-3.7-Flash optimized web chat - default URL http://127.0.0.1:8093
echo MTP off; context 4096; expert cache 8192 MiB; reuse and batch copies on.
"%~dp0.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -X utf8 -m serve.server --engine strata --config "%STEP_PROFILE%" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8093 --open %*
set "STEP_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if not "%STEP_EXIT_CODE%"=="0" pause
exit /b %STEP_EXIT_CODE%
long_check_source:
import hashlib,json,os,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from tools.check_step35_engine import Engine
from tools.check_step35_model import Monitor

def main():
    out=ROOT/'build-local/step35-cuda/step18-fast/long'
    out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    cfg=json.loads((ROOT/'build-local/step35-cuda/step18-fast-profile/step37.json').read_text())
    ref=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/Step-3.7-Flash/STEP37_FLASH_ADMISSION_MODEL.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    base=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/Step-3.7-Flash/STEP37_FLASH_MODEL_VALIDATION.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    os.environ['PATH']=os.pathsep.join(cfg['lib_dirs']+[os.environ['PATH']])
    engine=None;monitor=Monitor()
    report={'status':'error','scope':'native fast profile: full-model 511+16 through SWA512 and subsequent short requests',
            'engine_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(cfg['exe']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'requests':[]}
    try:
        engine=Engine(Path(cfg['exe']),Path(ref['model']),out,logits=True,on_start=monitor.start,extra_args=cfg['args'][2:])
        report['info']=engine.info
        assert 'expert_cache_reuse=1' in engine.info[0] and 'expert_pipeline_batch=1' in engine.info[0]
        medium=next(r for r in ref['runs'][0]['requests'] if r.get('key')=='medium')
        prompts=[('medium511',ref['medium_prompt']['ids'],16,medium)]
        controls=base['runs'][0]['requests']
        prompts += [(f'P1_{i}',p['ids'],128,controls[i]) for i,p in enumerate(base['prompts'])]
        for name,tokens,count,control in prompts:
            start=time.perf_counter()
            result=engine.generate(tokens,count,sampling='temperature=0')
            digest=hashlib.sha256((out/'logits.f32').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            result.update(name=name,prompt_tokens=len(tokens),logits_sha256=digest,
                exact_reference_ids=result['ids']==control['ids'],exact_reference_logits=digest==control['logits_sha256'])
            report['requests'].append(result)
            assert result['exact_reference_ids'] and result['exact_reference_logits'],name
            print(name,len(result['ids']),'exact IDs/logits',round(time.perf_counter()-start,2),'s',flush=True)
        engine.close();report['exit_code']=engine.process.returncode
        assert report['exit_code']==0 and not monitor.error,monitor.error
        report['status']='pass'
    finally:
        if engine and not engine.stderr.closed:engine.close()
        monitor.close()
        report.update(memory_samples=monitor.samples,monitor_error=monitor.error)
        (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    return report
if __name__=='__main__':main()
